title: The stss entry_count = 0 cause the ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
body:
Hi , 
I have a plain mp4 can't be played in exoplayer , but it play in other player (even in Android gallery).
After I verified , its data is right but its atom of stss type seem having some error and the wrong stss will cause the ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

If I make the stss is null , then the video can be played .
`ParsableByteArray stss =null;`

Is possible for fix it ? Thank you!

**Update**
**I find this stss issue is same as [issue 554](https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/issues/554) , but it is stss not STSC now.**
**(The stss size is 12 + 4 , and entry_count = 0 )**

The video is: [error.mp4](https://mega.nz/#!pcZ02LyC!j-zeVbs0Lx8zl3E5at3aMoP_uHHLFrtPiucCzizZ2Uo)
